name: wet-hair-sheer-fashion
image_vibe: Elegant moody clean editorial, monochrome cream and black, soft high-key studio
image_purpose: Create a fashion lookbook portrait focused on wet-look hair, mesh texture, and refined styling.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic medium upper-body high-fashion portrait in a minimalist studio.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with almond-shaped hazel-green eyes, light-brown hair with honey-blonde highlights slicked back in a damp wet-look texture flowing down her back, fair natural skin, bold black winged eyeliner, neutral eyeshadow, defined brows, nude satin lipstick, and a focused elegant gaze. She wears a sheer black long-sleeved mesh top with fine vertical pleats over a black spaghetti-strap camisole, with loose sleeves and a high circular neckline on the overlay.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium upper-body portrait, clean off-white or minimalist-gray backdrop, monochromatic black/cream palette, sharp facial focus, visible mesh pleats and layered garment construction.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused high-key studio lighting with minimal facial shadows, clean elegant mood, and controlled natural skin rendering.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens at f/2.8, photorealistic high-resolution fashion photography, shallow depth of field, fine skin texture, visible fabric weave, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic medium upper-body high-fashion portrait of an original adult woman with almond-shaped hazel-green eyes, light-brown hair with honey-blonde highlights slicked back in a damp wet-look texture flowing down her back, fair natural skin, bold black winged eyeliner, neutral eyeshadow, defined brows, nude satin lipstick, and a focused elegant gaze. She wears a sheer black long-sleeved mesh top with fine vertical pleated texture over a black spaghetti-strap camisole, with loose sleeves and a high circular neckline on the overlay. Use a clean off-white or minimalist-gray backdrop, soft diffused high-key studio lighting, monochromatic black and cream palette, 85mm f/2.8 shallow depth, sharp facial focus, fine skin texture, visible fabric weave, and high-fashion editorial mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent underlayer, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text, deformed

assets.name: source wet-look fashion reference
assets.usage: Use only for hair, makeup, mesh layering, portrait crop, lighting, and editorial mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult original subject, wet-look hair, black mesh overlay, camisole layer, high-key backdrop, 85mm portrait treatment, and monochrome fashion direction. Keep the underlayer opaque and replaceable details equivalent.

changes: Removed public-figure resemblance and clarified an original adult subject.
Specified an opaque underlayer and added safety exclusions while preserving the sheer-mesh editorial concept.
